@Sofia, the two figures in #coastal-team on Nov 17 were 12% and then 10%. Bettina's follow-up that day says to ignore the 12%, that it's 10%, and that she'd misread a draft worksheet from June Osei-Lark. So 10% is the figure that was posted as correct.

Before you put it in the renewal brief, check it against the signed order form with June. The chat only shows a draft worksheet as the source, and I couldn't find a final document in what I can see. The Coastal cheat sheet also says Anselm has to approve any discount over 10%, so if the signed number is higher, that approval would need to be on record.
